27600.commentary: (SNa) sandacchāyo nāma saṃsanditvā ṭhitacchāyo. (BVa) sandacchāyo'ti ghanacchāyo, aviralattā'va sandacchāyo'ti vutto.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sāriputta, rukkho same bhūmibhāge jāto bahalapattapalāso sandacchāyo.
kamm'antaṭṭhāne eko jamburukkho bahalapattapalāso sandacchāyo ahosi.

examples.text: manorame āyatane, sevanti naṃ vihaṅ'gamā, chāyaṃ chāy'atthikā yanti, phal'atthā phalabhojino.

27602.commentary: (ANa) chāyaṃ chāy'atthikā yantī'ti chāyāya atthikā'va chāyaṃ upagacchanti.

examples.text: manorame āyatane, sevanti naṃ vihaṅgamā, chāyaṃ chāy'atthino yanti, phalatthā phalabhojino.
antaken'ādhipannassa, jahato mānusaṃ bhavaṃ, kiñ'hi tassa sakaṃ hoti, kiñ'ca ādāya gacchati, kiñ'c'assa anugaṃ hoti, chāyā'va anapāyinī.
manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce pasannena, bhāsati vā karoti vā. tato naṃ sukham'anveti, chāyā'va anapāyinī

atha naṃ rājā ādāsehi parikkhipāpesi. so attano'va chāyaṃ disvā ñātakā me āgatā'ti maññamāno pakkhena tāḷaṃ datvā mañjussarena maṇivaṃsaṃ dhamamāno viya viravi. sakalanagare manussā mattā viya laḷiṃsu.

27607.meaning1: like a shadow that never leaves

examples.text: manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce pasannena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ sukhamanveti, chāyā'va anapāyinī.
tañ'hi tassa sakaṃ hoti, tañ'ca ādāya gacchati, tañ'c'assa anugaṃ hoti, chāyā'va anapāyinī.

27608.meaning1: with lots of shade and water

examples.text: siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno koci'd'eva paccayo tena cīvarena vippavāsāya, chārattaparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tena cīvarena vippavasitabbaṃ. tato ce uttari vippavaseyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

27610.meaning1: maximum of six days; six days at the most

examples.text: chārattaparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tena cīvarena vippavasitabban'ti chārattaparamatā vippavasitabbaṃ.

27611.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of chārattaparama
27611.meaning1: for six days at the most; not more than six days
27611.meaningLit: for six nights at the most

examples.text: siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno koci'd'eva paccayo tena cīvarena vippavāsāya, chārattaparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tena cīvarena vippavasitabbaṃ. tato ce uttari vippavaseyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

27612.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of chāratta
27612.construction:
chaḷ > chā + ratta + aṃ
chāratta + aṃ

examples.text: parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttari chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ, ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho, tattha so bhikkhu abbhetabbo.

27613.meaning1: lacking six days; six days less
27613.commentary: (ANa) chahi māsehi chāratt'ūnehī'ti so kira raññā āṇattadivase'y'eva sabb'ūpakaraṇāni sajjetvā antevāsikehi saddhiṃ araññaṃ pavisitvā gāmadvāragāmamajjhadevakulasusān'ādīsu ṭhitarukkhe c'eva jhāmapatitasukkharukkhe ca vivajjetvā sampannapadese ṭhite sabbadosavivajjite nābhi-ara-nemīnaṃ anurūpe rukkhe gahetvā taṃ cakkaṃ akāsi. tassa rukkhe vicinitvā gaṇhantassa c'eva karontassa ca ettako kālo vītivatto. tena vuttaṃ, chahi māsehi chāratt'ūnehī'ti.

examples.text: sakkomi devā'ti kho, bhikkhave, rathakāro rañño sacetanassa paccassosi. atha kho, bhikkhave, rathakāro chahi māsehi chāratt'ūnehi ekaṃ cakkaṃ niṭṭhāpesi.

27614.commentary: (ANa) n'eva chārikā paññāyati na masī'ti cakkavāḷamahāpathavī sinerupabbatarājā himavā cakkavāḷapabbato cha kāmasaggā paṭhamajjhānikabrahmalokā'ti ettake ṭhāne daḍḍhe accharāya gahetabbamattāpi chārikā vā aṅgāro vā na paññāyati.

examples.text: jhāyamānassa kho pana bhagavato sarīrassa yaṃ ahosi chavī'ti vā camman'ti vā maṃsan'ti vā nhārū'ti vā lasikāti vā, tassa n'eva chārikā paññāyittha, na masi, sarīrān'eva avasissiṃsu.

27617.meaning1: which appeared on the sixth day; which becomes available on the fifth day after

examples.text: ch'āh'uppanne mūlacīvare paccāsācīvaraṃ uppajjati, das'āhā kāretabbaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ayaṃ mahāpathavī ek'odakā assa. tatra puriso ekacchiggaḷaṃ yugaṃ pakkhipeyya.

atha kho āyasmā mahako vihāraṃ pavisitvā sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhari yathā tālacchiggaḷena ca aggaḷ'antarikāya ca acci nikkhamitvā tiṇāni jhāpesi, uttar'āsaṅgaṃ na jhāpesi.
yāva hi vanatho na chijjati, aṇumatto'pi narassa nārisu, paṭibaddhamano'va tāva so, vaccho khīrapako'va mātari.
yattha nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhati, paṭighaṃ rūpasaññā ca, etth'esā chijjate jaṭā'ti.

27622.commentary: (SNa) asaṃsaggena chijjatī'ti ekato ṭhānanisajj'ādīni akarontassa asaṃsaggena adassanena chijjati.

examples.text: saṃsaggā vanatho jāto, asaṃsaggena chijjati, parittaṃ dārum'āruyha, yathā sīde mah'aṇṇave.
sace p'āyasmantānaṃ licchavīnaṃ evam'assa, mayaṃ acelaṃ pāthikaputtaṃ varattāhi bandhitvā goyugehi āviñcheyyāmāti, tā varattā chijjeyyuṃ pāthikaputto vā.

dissati kho, gāmaṇi, idh'ekacco daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā, dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā, dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chijjamāno.
agārā nikkhamanto'pi, rathena nikkhamiṃ ahaṃ, kesesu chijjamānesu, arahattama'pāpuṇiṃ.

tasmiṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, yaññe n'eva gāvo haññiṃsu, na aj'eḷakā haññiṃsu, na kukkuṭasūkarā haññiṃsu, na vividhā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjiṃsu, na rukkhā chijjiṃsu yūp'atthāya, na dabbhā lūyiṃsu barihis'atthāya

27627.meaning1: was cut; was sliced; was severed

examples.text: brāhmaṇassa asiṃ ākaḍḍhitvā upasiṅghantassa maricacuṇṇāni nāsaṃ pavisitvā khipitu'kāmataṃ uppādesuṃ. tassa khipantassa nāsikā asidhārāya paṭihatā dvidhā chijji.
ath'assa ratho samuddapiṭṭhena vegena gacchanto simbalivanaṃ pakkhanto, tassa gamanamagge simbalivanaṃ naḷavanaṃ viya chijjitvā chijjitvā samuddapiṭṭhe patati.
okañ'jahaṃ taṇhacchidaṃ anejaṃ, nandiñ'jahaṃ oghatiṇṇaṃ vimuttaṃ, kappañ'jahaṃ abhiyāce sumedhaṃ, sutvāna nāgassa apanamissanti ito.
asaṃsayassa kusalassa, venayikassa sārathivarassa, anuttarassa ruciradhammassa, nikkaṅkhassa pabhāsakassa, mānacchidassa vīrassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāsaṃ ākāsagataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, kaṇṇacchiddaṃ nāsacchiddaṃ mukhadvāraṃ, yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ ajjhoharati… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā ākāsadhātu.
cha lokasmiṃ chiddāni, yattha vittaṃ na tiṭṭhati, ālasyañ'ca pamādo ca, anuṭṭhānaṃ asaṃyamo, niddā tandī ca te chidde, sabbaso taṃ vivajjaye'ti.

27632.commentary: (ANa) yassa pana vemajjhe bhinnaṃ, tassa chiddasāṭako viya chiddaṃ nāma hoti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvasamāno evaṃ jānāti, dīgharattaṃ kho ayam'āyasmā khaṇḍakārī chiddakārī sabalakārī kammāsakārī, na santatakārī na santatavutti, sīlesu dussīlo ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā sīlavā'ti.
seyyathā'pi puriso medakathālikaṃ parihareyya chidda-avachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ, evam'evaṃ kho ahaṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharāmi

27633.commentary: (ANa) yassa pana vemajjhe bhinnaṃ, tassa chiddasāṭako viya chiddaṃ nāma hoti.

examples.text: idam'pi kho, brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyassa khaṇḍam'pi chiddam'pi sabalam'pi kammāsam'pi.

27636.meaning1: whose behaviour is broken; whose conduct is blemished

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvasamāno evaṃ jānāti, dīgharattaṃ kho ayam'āyasmā khaṇḍakārī chiddakārī sabalakārī kammāsakārī, na santatakārī na santatavutti, sīlesu dussīlo ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā sīlavā'ti.

27637.meaning2: looking for others' faults or weak points

27638.meaning1: broken water-jar; water container full of holes

27639.meaning1: torn cloth; cloth with a hole

examples.text: akhaṇḍānī'ti-ādīsu yassa sattasu āpattikkhandhesu ādimhi vā ante vā sikkhāpadaṃ bhinnaṃ hoti, tassa sīlaṃ pariyante chinnasāṭako viya khaṇḍaṃ nāma. yassa pana vemajjhe bhinnaṃ, tassa chiddasāṭako viya chiddaṃ nāma hoti.
parisuddho no vacīsamācāro bhavissati uttāno vivaṭo na ca chiddavā saṃvuto ca

27642.meaning2: full of holes; full of large or small holes

27644.meaning1: full of holes; with holes above and below; (comm) with large and small holes
27644.commentary: (ANa) chidd'āvachiddan'ti parittamahantehi chiddehi samannāgataṃ… navahi vaṇamukhehi parittamahanta chiddaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, puriso medakathālikaṃ parihareyya chidd'āvachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ, evam'evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharāmi chidd'āvachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ.
vanaṃ chindatha mā rukkhaṃ, vanato jāyate bhayaṃ, chetvā vanañ'ca vanathañ'ca, nibbanā hotha bhikkhavo.
udāhu vippalapan'tass'eva coraghātā sīsaṃ chindeyyun'ti
so taṃ thūṇaṃ khaṇḍ'ākhaṇḍikaṃ chindeyya. khaṇḍ'ākhaṇḍikaṃ chetvā phāleyya. phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya. sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ katvā vāt'ātape visoseyya. vāt'ātape visosetvā agginā ḍaheyya.

27648.meaning1: (of a tree) cuts down; fells (something at)

examples.text: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imaṃ rukkhaṃ mūlato chetvā yāva'd'atthañ'ca khādeyyaṃ ucchaṅgañ'ca pūreyyan'ti. so taṃ rukkhaṃ mūlato'va chindeyya.

santi, gahapatayo, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, karoto kārayato, chindato chedāpayato, pacato pācāpayato, socayato socāpayato, kilamato kilamāpayato, phandato phandāpayato… karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ.

santi, gahapatayo, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino… pāṇam'atipātayato, adinnaṃ ādiyato, sandhiṃ chindato, nillopaṃ harato, ekāgārikaṃ karoto, paripanthe tiṭṭhato, paradāraṃ gacchato, musā bhaṇato, karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ.

27654.grammar: pr, caus & pass of chindīyati, trans (+acc)

27656.meaning1: caused to cut; caused to slice

examples.text: taṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhamitvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sunisedhaṃ nisedhesuṃ, mūlaghaccaṃ akaṃsu, sīsam'assa chindiṃsu.
ettakena'pi mayaṃ āyasmato channassa attamanā api nāma taṃ āyasmā channo āvi akāsi khīlaṃ chindi. odah'āvuso, channa, sotaṃ, bhabbo'si dhammaṃ viññātun'ti.

27659.commentary: (SNa) chinditamārite'ti chindite ca mārite ca. (SNt) chindite'ti hatthacched'ādi-vasena chede.

examples.text: idha chinditamārite, hatajānīsu kassapo, na pāpaṃ samanupassati, puññaṃ vā pana attano, sa ve vissāsam'ācikkhi, satthā arahati mānanan'ti.

27660.meaning1: cutting and killing; injuring and murdering

examples.text: idha chinditamārite, hatajānīsu kassapo, na pāpaṃ samanupassati, puññaṃ vā pana attano, sa ve vissāsam'ācikkhi, satthā arahati mānanan'ti.
asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pabbajitassa n'ābhijānāmi satthena cīvaraṃ chinditā.

27662.meaning1: having cut off; having cut to size

examples.text: sāmantā sugatavidatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāyā'ti thirabhāvāya vaṭṭaṃ vā caturassaṃ vā chinditvā ekadese vā santharitabbaṃ vijaṭetvā vā santharitabbaṃ.
aññatra heṭṭhimāya aṭaniyā'ti ṭhapetvā heṭṭhimaṃ aṭaniṃ, taṃ atikkāmetvā karoti vā kārāpeti vā, payoge dukkaṭaṃ, paṭilābhena chinditvā pācittiyaṃ desetabbaṃ.

27663.meaning1: having cut off; having severed; having destroyed

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma purāṇaṃ bandhanaṃ chinditvā aññaṃ navaṃ bandhanaṃ kareyya, evaṃsampadam'idaṃ pāpakaṃ lobhadhammaṃ vadāmi, kiñ'hi paro parassa karissatī'ti.

27666.meaning1: should cut; should cut off; should sever

examples.text: pañca chinde pañca jahe, pañca c'uttari bhāvaye, pañcasaṅg'ātigo bhikkhu, oghatiṇṇo'ti vuccati.
sukhañ'hi vaḍḍha munayo, anejā chinnasaṃsayā, sītibhūtā damappattā, viharanti anāsavā.
yathā'pi mūle anupaddave daḷhe, chinno'pi rukkho punareva rūhati, evam'pi taṇh'ānusaye anūhate, nibbattatī dukkham'idaṃ punappunaṃ.
yo atītaṃ ādisati, anejo chinnasaṃsayo, pāraguṃ sabbadhammānaṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ.
yathā sākaṭiko maṭṭhaṃ, samaṃ hitvā mahāpathaṃ, visamaṃ maggam'āruyha, akkhacchinno'vajhāyati.
evaṃ dhammā apakkamma, adhammam'anuvattiya, mando maccumukhaṃ patto, akkhacchinno'va jhāyatī'ti.
seyyathā'pi nāma tittak'ālābu āmakacchinno vāt'ātapena saṃphuṭito hoti sammilāto, evam'ev'assu me sīsacchavi saṃphuṭitā hoti sammilātā tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

27671.meaning1: (of a stream) cut across; breasted; forded

examples.text: chinnaṃ pāpimato sotaṃ, viddhastaṃ vinaḷīkataṃ, pāmojjabahulā hotha, khemaṃ patt'attha bhikkhavo'ti.
yo'dha kāme accatari, saṅgaṃ loke duraccayaṃ, na so socati n'ājjheti, chinnasoto abandhano.

27674.meaning2: cut; made up of cut pieces of cloth

examples.text: na munī gāmam'āgamma, kulesu sahasā care, ghās'esanaṃ chinnakatho, na vācaṃ payutaṃ bhaṇe.

27677.commentary: (MNa) chinnakukkuccan'ti vippaṭisārakukkuccassa c'eva hatthapādakukkuccassa ca chinnattā chinnakukkuccaṃ.

examples.text: yathāvādī kho, āvuso, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya na kenaci loke viggayha tiṭṭhati, yathā ca pana kāmehi visaṃyuttaṃ viharantaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ akathaṃkathiṃ chinnakukkuccaṃ bhav'ābhave vītataṇhaṃ saññā n'ānusenti

27678.meaning1: who has cut the tie; who has severed the knot

examples.text: pahāsi saṅkhaṃ na vimānam'ajjhagā, acchecchi taṇhaṃ idha nāmarūpe, taṃ chinnaganthaṃ anighaṃ nirāsaṃ, pariyesamānā n'ājjhagamuṃ, devā manussā idha vā huraṃ vā, saggesu vā sabbanivesanesu.

27683.meaning1: who has cut off mental proliferation; (comm) severed desire, conceit and views
27683.meaning2: who has cut off mental proliferation
27683.commentary: (DNa) chinnapapañce'ti ettha papañcā nāma taṇhā māno diṭṭhī'ti ime tayo kilesā.

examples.text: yatra hi nāma tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātito'pi anussarissati

27684.meaning2: falling as if cut down; or with a sudden steep fall(?) headlong, precipitately

27685.meaning1: who has cut one's own path; blocked the way

examples.text: pārājiko vā hoti chinnaparipantho, aññataraṃ vā saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, bāḷhaṃ vā rog'ātaṅkaṃ phusati, sammūḷho kālaṃ karoti, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.

27686.commentary: (DNa) chinnapātaṃ papatantī'ti majjhe chinnā viya hutvā yato vā tato vā papatanti.

examples.text: sant'ānanda, devatā ākāse pathavīsaññiniyo kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti, āvaṭṭanti, vivaṭṭanti, atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antaradhāyissatī'ti.

27687.meaning1: free from patchwork; cut from a single cloth
27687.commentary: (MNa) chinnapilotiko'ti pilotikā vuccati chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ tattha tattha sibbitaṃ gaṇṭhikataṃ jiṇṇaṃ vatthaṃ, taṃ yassa n'atthi, aṭṭhahatthaṃ vā navahatthaṃ vā ahatasāṭakaṃ nivattho, so chinnapilotiko nāma. ayam'pi dhammo tādiso, na h'ettha kohaññ'ādi-vasena chinna-bhinna-sibbita-gaṇṭhikata-bhāvo atthi. apica kacavaro pilotiko'ti vuccati. imasmiñ'ca sāsane samaṇakacavaraṃ nāma patiṭṭhātuṃ na labhati.

examples.text: evaṃ svākkhāte, bhikkhave, mayā dhamme uttāne vivaṭe pakāsite chinnapilotike ye te bhikkhū arahanto khīṇ'āsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanā samma'd'aññā vimuttā, vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ n'atthi paññāpanāya.

27689.meaning1: with no crinkling; rid of crackling

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, biḷārabhastā madditā sumadditā suparimadditā, mudukā tūlinī chinnasassarā chinnabhabbharā. atha puriso āgaccheyya kaṭṭhaṃ vā kathalaṃ vā ādāya.

27692.meaning1: cut off at the root; severed at the source
27692.commentary: (ANa) chinnamūlako'ti mūlabhūtānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ upacchinnattā chinnamūlako. (THa) tiṭṭhanti chinnamūlakā'ti sabbaso pariññātattā eva tesaṃ avijjātaṇhādikassa mūlassa samucchinnattā ariyamaggena pahīnattā yāvacarimacittanirodhā te tiṭṭhanti.

examples.text: pañcakkhandhā pariññātā, tiṭṭhanti chinnamūlakā, dhi tavatthu jare jamme, n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, ye te bhikkhū bahussutā āgat'āgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā, te na sakkaccaṃ sutt'antaṃ paraṃ vācenti. tesaṃ accayena chinnamūlako sutt'anto hoti appaṭisaraṇo. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo dhammo saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattati.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, biḷārabhastā madditā sumadditā suparimadditā, mudukā tūlinī chinnasassarā chinnabhabbharā. atha puriso āgaccheyya kaṭṭhaṃ vā kathalaṃ vā ādāya.
yo atītaṃ ādisati, anejo chinnasaṃsayo, pāraguṃ sabbadhammānaṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ.

27695.commentary: (ANt) pariyante chinnasāṭako viyā'ti tatr'ante das'ante vā chinnavatthaṃ viya. visadis'udāharaṇañ'c'etaṃ akhaṇḍānī'ti imassa adhikatattā. evaṃ sesānam'pi udāharaṇāni. khaṇḍikatā bhinnatā khaṇḍaṃ, taṃ etassa atthī'ti khaṇḍaṃ, sīlaṃ.

examples.text: akhaṇḍānī'ti-ādīsu yassa sattasu āpattikkhandhesu ādimhi vā ante vā sikkhāpadaṃ bhinnaṃ hoti, tassa sīlaṃ pariyante chinnasāṭako viya khaṇḍaṃ nāma. yassa pana vemajjhe bhinnaṃ, tassa chiddasāṭako viya chiddaṃ nāma hoti.

27696.meaning1: corpse with the head cut off; decapitated head

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sivathikaṃ gantvā chinnasīsaṃ passitvā vaṭṭakate mukhe chupantaṃ aṅgajātaṃ pavesesi. tassa kukkuccaṃ ahosi… āpattiṃ tvaṃ, bhikkhu, āpanno pārājikan'ti.

27697.meaning1: who has cut the stream (of craving or becoming)

examples.text: yo'dha kāme accatari, saṅgaṃ loke duraccayaṃ, na so socati n'ājjheti, chinnasoto abandhano.
yassa ca visatā n'atthi, chinnasotassa bhikkhuno, kicc'ākiccappahīnassa, pariḷāho na vijjati.

27698.meaning1: who has brought the path to an end; who has broken the cycle
27698.meaning2: who has brought the path to an end; who has broken the cycle

examples.text: yatra hi nāma tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātito'pi anussarissati

27699.meaning2: whose garments are taken by force
